bagPolicy.summary: Franklin Music Hall does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking information is not explicitly detailed on the website. Visitors are advised to check nearby parking facilities or street parking options. Pricing and availability may vary.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Franklin Music Hall's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Small bites and nonalcoholic drinks are sold in the lobby between merchandise and coat check. Alcohol is available in designated 21-and-over areas with valid ID; outside food and beverages are prohibited.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Franklin Music Hall, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Franklin Music Hall's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: On show days the box office will open 2 hours before the scheduled door time. You may also purchase tickets for all Franklin Music Hall shows with NO SERVICE FEES directly from our box office (421 N 7th Street) on Fridays 12pm-6pm.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Franklin Music Hall. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
